note: Speaker labels the per-track audio overrides on the diarizer. Consumed by stage2_transcript.py --overrides, so the transcript has exactly one writer and re-running stage 2 does not silently undo this pass.
method: Per-track RMS over each turn's window, mapped master->mix through edit_map. Decisive margin 6.0 dB; below that the diarizer's label stands because that is simultaneous speech, not a mislabel.
